numerical_time_step_contract.steps: input dt, dt/2, dt/4; independently spin up every run
numerical_time_step_contract.per_bin_fine_difference_limit: strictly less than 0.1 times documented observational 1-sigma uncertainty
numerical_time_step_contract.trend: fine difference smaller than coarse difference; exact zero at both levels is zero measured sensitivity
numerical_time_step_contract.failure_action: FAIL and preserve numerical artifacts without computing observational residuals or plots; do not relax the criterion
numerical_time_step_contract.scope: thermal time-step sensitivity only; not spatial convergence or observational agreement

name: Time-dependent thermal inertia and eclipse response
purpose: Drive the linked depth-resolved production thermal state through sunrise, sunset, and the frozen eclipse training/hold-out intervals and evaluate convergence plus hold-out residuals.
production_capability: Depth-resolved thermal evolution under terrain and finite-apparent-disc Earth-eclipse illumination, observation-free periodic full-column spin-up, plus a matching grey-emissivity bolometric observation operator.
configuration: Explicit srcMoon/examples/lola_surface.in M2 receipt; eight MPI ranks; thermal-model mode; paired RDR history/selection-contract paths; apparent-disc-overlap direct irradiance with a uniform 695700000 m solar disc, opaque 6371000 m solid Earth, disabled terrestrial-atmosphere transmission, and no limb darkening; a 2551442.976 s pre-training periodic interval; 0.01 K node and 10000 J m^-2 column-enthalpy spin-up tolerances; no Diviner-initialized thermal state.
inputs: PDS4 RDR v3.1 June training history
PDS4 RDR v3.1 December untouched hold-out history
independent_reference: U11 analytical thermal invariants and independently processed native calibrated RDR radiances evaluated with the published Paige et al. C3-C9 bolometric algorithm; never frozen production output as physical truth.
units: SI model units; W m^-2 sr^-1 RDR channel radiance; K brightness/kinetic temperature; degrees and UTC retained from native labels
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 model surface geometry; native RDR planetocentric positive-east FOV coordinates; SPICE TDB internally; RDR SCET UTC externally; each channel retains actual footprint/time/detector geometry
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic observation processing and thermal evolution; random seed and MPI/OpenMP layout still recorded; thermal time step is varied explicitly for convergence.
procedure: Verify I13/D03/hash prerequisites; process radiance before temperature with frozen flags/bins; stage June-only rows; perform observation-independent periodic full-column spin-up until both input tolerances pass; run the normal finite-disc/terrain thermal state; compare epsilon*sigma*T^4 as bolometric_brightness_temperature_K; emit an EXPERIMENTAL June plot and review-only threshold candidate; freeze thresholds only after review; later expose and score December once; preserve row-level and plotted artifacts.
metrics: June and December bolometric weighted bias/RMSE/coverage
C6-C9 radiance and brightness-temperature diagnostic residuals
acceptance_criteria: No unphysical discontinuity; <50 K per production update; demonstrated dt convergence; phase/amplitude satisfy thresholds derived and frozen from June plus documented calibration/within-bin uncertainty before December is scored. C6-C9 grey-passband residuals are diagnostics, not primary gates. Thresholds are never relaxed after execution.
expected_pass_result: The declared linked M2 capability is evaluated and every frozen criterion is met.
required_data: D03 Diviner RDR; 2011-06-15 training and 2011-12-10 hold-out
data_hashes: Every consumed ZIP/XML product, processed history, D03 QA record, Paige selection contract, and calibration reference is recorded before launch.
status_semantics: PASS means all linked numerical and untouched hold-out criteria ran and passed; FAIL means all prerequisites existed but a frozen criterion was missed; ERROR is build/runtime/parser/hash/ZIP/label corruption or resource exhaustion; SKIPPED means a predecessor, capability, configuration, authoritative input, spin-up qualification, or pre-holdout threshold freeze is unavailable. A June EXPERIMENTAL comparison plot and review-only threshold candidate still return SKIPPED / NOT VALIDATED. Preprocessing alone is never validation.
